affected_system: rights-preserving compliance assistance, incentives, inspections, and enforcement
alternatives: protect minimum coverage before needs-based allocation of compliance assistance, inspection, and appeal resources
adapt allocations using observed demand, uptake, and capacity for compliance assistance, inspection, and appeal resources

assumptions: Eligibility, notice, awareness, capability, action, inspection, violation, sanction, and outcome remain distinct.
No behavioral score automatically triggers enforcement, benefit denial, or coercive action.
All alternatives, capacities, costs, effects, thresholds, and failure scenarios are proposed until bound to evidence.

constraints.description: The compliance, incentives, and behavioral policy allocate must respect declared minimum service, eligibility, capacity, and distributional safeguards.
Every released metric must retain evidence type, source lineage, geography, time, assumptions, and uncertainty.
No analytical output may bypass lawful authority, accountable human review, or an applicable appeal process.

decision_cadence: recompiled at each planning cycle and after material evidence change
decision_owner: regulatory operations director and behavioral insights lead
decision_question: How should navigators, technical aid, incentives, inspectors, language, and appeal support be assigned?

independence_key.binding_constraint: The compliance, incentives, and behavioral policy allocate must respect declared minimum service, eligibility, capacity, and distributional safeguards.
independence_key.decision_object: compliance assistance, inspection, and appeal resources
independence_key.evidence_gate: Evidence for compliance assistance, inspection, and appeal resources passes documented checks for eligible denominators, group attributes, inventory, minimum-service rules, and allocation records.
independence_key.intervention_mechanism: rights, severity, minimum-assistance, skill, and equity allocation
independence_key.primary_outcome: priority cases without qualified assistance or review capacity

intended_claim: A versioned allocate design for comparing declared alternatives affecting compliance assistance, inspection, and appeal resources, conditional on its evidence gate.
limitations: This library record has no city binding and therefore reports no local input, output, or recommendation.
Readiness describes explicit source and method gates; it does not certify implementation feasibility.
External domain, legal, community, security, and operational review remains outside this design artifact.

objectives.metric: priority cases without qualified assistance or review capacity
distributional gap in priority cases without qualified assistance or review capacity
decision claims with complete evidence lineage

prohibited_claims: Do not report assigned assistance or inspection as contact, compliance, violation, sanction, or resolution.
Do not describe a design-only record as a city execution, deployment, adopted policy, or impact result.
Do not relabel proposed, estimated, simulated, optimized, or causal evidence as observed evidence.
Do not infer individual behavior, protected status, harm, or entitlement from aggregate records.

release_gate.failure_release: Release an explicit insufficient-evidence record naming missing sources, failed diagnostics, prohibited claims, and the next validation action.
release_gate.pass_condition: Evidence for compliance assistance, inspection, and appeal resources passes documented checks for eligible denominators, group attributes, inventory, minimum-service rules, and allocation records.

title: Allocate compliance assistance and inspection capacity
transportability_risks: Law, administrative burden, trust, incentives, capability, enforcement, and baseline behavior differ.
Observed compliance may reflect detection and documentation rather than underlying behavior.
